name: nordicnrf54l-unofficial
title: Nordic nRF54L (unofficial, via nrf54-arduino-core)
description: PlatformIO port of this core for XIAO nRF54L15 and related boards.

_NOTES.flags_source: Compile/link recipe values in builder/ are transcribed directly from this repo's own platform.txt/boards.txt (v1.0.17), not guessed.
_NOTES.bypassed: This repo's own upload.py / nrf_ocd / tools.nrf54upload chain is intentionally not used here. Upload goes through pyOCD directly (target 'nrf54l', CMSIS-DAP), confirmed working against real XIAO nRF54L15 hardware.
_NOTES.toolchain_note: The Arduino IDE package pins arm-none-eabi-gcc 7-2017q4. platform.txt's actual flags (gnu11/gnu++17, no explicit -mfpu, soft float) don't depend on GCC-7-specific behavior, so PlatformIO's own newer toolchain-gccarmnoneeabi package has tested fine -- but this hasn't been exercised against every example/library in the repo, just a minimal sketch.
_NOTES.lm20a_status: Not yet supported in this PlatformIO platform -- only the XIAO nRF54L15 has a board manifest so far. The core itself supports the LM20A; this PlatformIO port just hasn't been extended to it yet.

framework-nrf54l15clean._NOTE: TEMPORARY, for pre-merge testing only: points at the fork+branch where package.json/platform.json/boards/builder are being added, since lolren's actual tags don't have them yet. Once this PR is merged into lolren/nrf54-arduino-core and a new release/tag is cut including these files, change this back to point at lolren's repo directly (e.g. https://github.com/lolren/nrf54-arduino-core.git#v1.0.21 or whatever the merged tag ends up being) -- don't ship the PR itself with this fork URL still in place.

tool-pyocd._NOTE: Must resolve to pyOCD >=0.44.0 for the built-in nrf54l target (confirmed present in this range against real hardware).
